visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with long, dark wavy hair, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and a silver necklace with a star-shaped pendant, sits at a wooden table. He is positioned in the center against a background of a well-lit studio kitchen featuring shelves with jars and bottles. He holds a green bag of 可樂果 chips with coriander branding. (2) He uses both hands to pull open the plastic snack bag with a forceful motion. After opening, he brings the bag directly to his face, taking a deep sniff. His facial expression immediately shifts into an exaggerated gagging reaction, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth in mock disgust while looking at the camera. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down close-up of spiral-shaped, orange-tinted chips scattered on a white ceramic plate. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the texture and the small green seasoning specks on the snacks. The wooden texture of the table is visible in the background, providing a warm aesthetic. (4) The creator holds a clear plastic tray containing six pale green macarons. He brings them close to the camera for an insert shot. He then picks one up and takes a bite, maintaining a neutral expression that quickly turns into a look of boredom and disappointment as he stares into the camera lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic pop background track plays at 124 BPM. A male voice speaks in a fast-paced Mandarin tone. A distinct 'pop' sound effect occurs exactly when the snack bag is opened, followed by the crisp sound of plastic crinkling. (2) The speaker makes a loud gagging sound in a comedic, high-pitched tone to signify disgust. The BGM remains constant. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between talking and the close-up shot of the chips. (3) A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect plays as the chips are shown. The music continues with a strong synthesized beat. The speaker's pitch variability is high to maintain audience engagement in a studio-clean recording environment. (4) A digital 'pop' SFX triggers as the macaron package is shown. The speaker’s tone becomes sarcastic. A low-frequency comedic 'thud' SFX is heard when the creator expresses disappointment, punctuating the negative review of the macarons.
